name: Glass of Mortlan
text: Each 6 you roll when resolving a Spell effect counts as 2 successes. You may prevent the loss of 1 Sanity when resolving your Spell effects.
flavor: Look through the lens and see the threads that bind the stars.

name: Grotesque Statue
text: When you gain this card from the deck, gain 5 Clues. Once per round, you may spend 1 Clue to prevent all Sanity loss from a single effect.

name: Lightning Gun
text: Gain +6 Strength when resolving a Combat Encounter. Action: You and each Monster on your space lose 1 Health.

action.text: You and each Monster on your space lose 1 Health.

flavor: Built in a canyon laboratory by creatures from Yuggoth.

name: Mi-go Brain Case
text: Action: You and another investigator may trade possessions. In addition, he may move to your space; if he does, move to his previous space. === Rulings, clarifications, and reminders === None of the exchanged possessions are considered "gained" or "discarded" as part of Mi-go Brain Case's ability.

text: During the Encounter Phase, you may choose an encounter as if there are no Monsters on your space.

name: Ruby of R'lyeh
text: Once per round, during the Action Phase, you may spend 1 Sanity and perform 1 additional action.

action.text: Spend 1 Sanity and perform 1 additional action.

name: Sword of Saint Jerome
text: Gain +2 Will and +5 Strength when resolving Combat Encounters. If you defeat a Monster during a Combat Encounter, recover 1 Sanity.
flavor: The blade still shines after a thousand years.

name: T'tka Halot

action.text: Test Lore. If you pass, you may spend 1 Sanity to choose 1 Monster on your space to lose 3 Health.

name: The Silver Key
text: Once per round, you may spend 1 less Clue to pay for an effect. You may reroll 1 die when resolving a test during an Other World Encounter.
flavor: Turn it in empty air, and the door opens.
